decisions.risk: Environment labels can drift between plans, reports, policy checks, and UI filters.
decisions.justification: Audit environments are selectable and reportable governed reference values.

decisions.risk: Plan lifecycle strings can drift across activation, completion, reporting, and clients.
decisions.justification: Internship audit-plan states are persisted and reportable workflow data.

decisions.risk: Severity vocabularies can diverge across triage, reporting, and access-scoped clients.
decisions.justification: Severity is governed report metadata and must not be independently defined by schema checks.

decisions.risk: Automation-level labels can drift from completion calculations and reporting.
decisions.justification: Automation strength is persisted audit-case metadata and requires a canonical definition.

decisions.risk: Execution states can drift across database constraints, backend rules, and client progress calculations.
decisions.justification: Test execution status is persisted, selectable, and reportable workflow data.

decisions.risk: A duplicated mutable-state subset can permit or deny inconsistent execution updates.
decisions.justification: Editable execution states are governed workflow-transition metadata.

decisions.risk: Hard-coded report types can diverge across storage, API validation, forms, and analytics.
decisions.justification: Internal report types are user-selectable feedback categories and require canonical persisted authority.

decisions.risk: Report lifecycle constraints can drift from backend transition policy and client state.
decisions.justification: Internal report state is persisted and reportable workflow data.

decisions.risk: Priority vocabularies can diverge across triage, queues, exports, and notifications.
decisions.justification: Priority is governed report metadata and requires canonical persisted authority.

decisions.risk: Evidence-type drift can break validation, privacy handling, and audit exports.
decisions.justification: Evidence kinds are persisted report metadata with distinct storage and security behavior.

decisions.risk: Comment-type drift can corrupt information-request and response history.
decisions.justification: Discussion event kinds are persisted, reportable workflow metadata.

decisions.risk: Retest outcome drift can produce incompatible closure and verification decisions.
decisions.justification: Retest outcomes are persisted and reportable workflow results.

decisions.risk: Delivery-mode drift can bypass digest expectations or create duplicate notifications.
decisions.justification: Notification delivery policy is persisted operational configuration and requires canonical authority.

decisions.risk: Backend report-type allowlists can diverge from persisted categories and generated clients.
decisions.justification: The backend list currently validates user-selectable feedback categories and should consume canonical records.

decisions.risk: Backend state allowlists can diverge from database constraints and client transitions.
decisions.justification: Internal report states are persisted, reportable workflow data and require canonical authority.

decisions.risk: Backend plan-state allowlists can drift from activation and completion rules.
decisions.justification: Audit-plan status is persisted and reportable workflow data.

decisions.risk: Backend execution-state allowlists can drift from schema and client progress calculations.
decisions.justification: Execution status is persisted and reportable workflow data.

decisions.risk: Duplicated terminal-state policy can produce incompatible completion calculations.
decisions.justification: Terminal execution semantics are governed workflow metadata and require one authority.

decisions.risk: Duplicated critical-completion policy can mark a plan ready despite unresolved blocking outcomes.
decisions.justification: Critical completion semantics are governed workflow metadata and require one authority.
